paraphrase: Seven kinds of persons: one freed both ways (touching the formless liberations and with effluents destroyed by wisdom), one freed by wisdom, the body-witness, one attained to view, one freed by faith, the Dhamma-follower and the faith-follower; for the last five there is still work to be done with diligence.

paraphrase: Final knowledge is not attained all at once but by gradual training, gradual practice, gradual progress: one with faith visits a teacher, attends, listens, remembers, examines, ponders, gains enthusiasm, will, weighs, strives and realises the ultimate truth with the body and sees it with wisdom.
